title: NeptuneConnection
description: Amazon Neptune property graph or RDF connection configuration

graphModel.description: Neptune graph model and query language.

awsConfig.title: AWS Credentials Configuration
awsConfig.description: AWS credentials used to sign (SigV4) requests to Neptune. Leave the keys blank to use the standard AWS credential provider chain, e.g. an IAM role. The identity needs `neptune-db:ReadDataViaQuery`; RDF also needs `neptune-db:GetGraphSummary`. Property-graph schema computation additionally needs `neptune-db:WriteDataViaQuery`.

enabled.title: Enable IAM Auth
enabled.description: Enable AWS IAM authentication. When enabled, uses the default credential provider chain (environment variables, instance profile, etc.). Defaults to false for backward compatibility.

profileName.title: Profile Name
profileName.description: The name of a profile to use with the boto session.

assumeRoleArn.title: Role Arn for Assume Role
assumeRoleArn.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume. Required Field in case of Assume Role

assumeRoleSessionName.title: Role Session Name for Assume Role
assumeRoleSessionName.description: An identifier for the assumed role session. Use the role session name to uniquely identify a session when the same role is assumed by different principals or for different reasons. Required Field in case of Assume Role

assumeRoleSourceIdentity.title: Source Identity for Assume Role
assumeRoleSourceIdentity.description: The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the role to assume. Optional Field in case of Assume Role

graphModel.title: Graph Model
graphModel.description: Choose the Neptune graph model. Existing configurations default to openCypher property graphs.

hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: Neptune cluster or instance endpoint, e.g. `my-cluster.cluster-abc.us-east-1.neptune.amazonaws.com:8182`. The port can be omitted to use 8182.

databaseName.title: Database Name
databaseName.description: Optional name to give to the database in OpenMetadata. If left blank, `default` is used.

includeRelationships.title: Include Relationships
includeRelationships.description: Also ingest edge labels as tables in the `relationships` schema, with their properties as columns.

computeSchemaIfMissing.title: Compute Schema If Missing
computeSchemaIfMissing.description: For property graphs, when Neptune has no computed schema, start `CALL neptune.graph.pg_schema.compute()` and wait for it to finish. This requires `neptune-db:WriteDataViaQuery`. Ignored for RDF, which uses the read-only graph summary API.

schemaComputeTimeoutSeconds.title: Schema Compute Timeout (seconds)
schemaComputeTimeoutSeconds.description: Maximum time to wait for Neptune to finish computing the property graph schema before failing.

rdfMaxClasses.title: Maximum RDF Classes
rdfMaxClasses.description: Maximum number of RDF classes to ingest as tables. Classes are selected deterministically by IRI; truncation is reported in the ingestion status.

rdfMaxPredicatesPerClass.title: Maximum RDF Predicates Per Class
rdfMaxPredicatesPerClass.description: Maximum number of predicates to ingest as columns for each RDF class. Truncation is reported in the ingestion status.

rdfSampleSize.title: RDF Subject Sample Size
rdfSampleSize.description: Maximum number of subjects sampled per RDF class when discovering predicates and value types.

rdfQueryTimeoutSeconds.title: RDF Query Timeout (seconds)
rdfQueryTimeoutSeconds.description: Per-query timeout for the bounded SPARQL class-discovery queries. Neptune requires this to be lower than the neptune_query_timeout database parameter.

propertyFilterPattern.title: Property Filter Pattern
propertyFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude node and edge properties (columns) that match the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude schemas that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude tables that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.
